title: Duecare harness chat — wheels
subtitle: v3.17 omni harness chat: 5 toggles + 4 grade modes + 9 model variants
description: v3.17 / chat-package 0.2.9 (2026-05-07) — 21-dim rubric, use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance. v0.2.9: Import tile now has SERVER-side storage with ZIP extraction. Five new endpoints (POST /api/import/upload accepts ZIP/.txt/.md, POST /api/import/snippet for paste, GET /api/import/list, GET/DELETE /api/import/<id>, DELETE /api/import). Server unpacks ZIPs, decodes text-like files, BM25-lite ranks them by query overlap at chat time and prepends only the top-N most-relevant docs to Gemma's context (avoids context-window blowout from 50-file ZIPs). Cap: 200 docs / 100 MB / 5 MB per file. Local-storage path retained as legacy migration only. Carries v0.2.8 per-step SSE progress + 6th Import layer. GREP rule set now ships 111 rules across 16 categories, including v3.17 digital-era additions for QR/mobile-wallet payment plans, side-letter two-contract deception, and digital credential-vault debt control. RAG corpus now ships 35 docs, including digital fee collection and side-letter deception briefs. Bundled wheels: duecare-llm-chat, duecare-llm-core, duecare-llm-models. Single CORE entry point: one configurable interface wiring every harness layer + 9 model variants (Gemma 4 E2B / E4B / 26B-A4B / 31B / 2 abliterated jailbroken / 3 cloud BYOK routes). Updates land here - bump this dataset version to refresh attached notebooks.
